definitions.explanation: The area of the sea away from the shore.

examples.english: The ship went out to sea.

examples.japanese: {沖|おき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いてきた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
examples.english: A strong wind blew in from offshore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漁師|りょうし}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{沖|おき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The fishermen head out to sea every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖合|おきあい}→沖合：19458_okiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦クジラ→鯨：04310_kujira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいる→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: We could see a large whale swimming offshore.

notes:
{沖|おき} refers to the open sea or offshore area, away from the shore or coast.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {沖|おき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out to sea
- {沖|おき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to head offshore
- {沖|おき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: wind blows from offshore

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{沖合|おきあい}→沖合：19458_okiai⟧: offshore area
- ⟦{沖釣|おきづ}り→沖釣り：noentry⟧: offshore fishing
- ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧: Okinawa (same kanji, different reading)

CONTRAST:
- {沖|おき}: open sea, offshore
- ⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧: shore, bank
- ⟦{浜|はま}→浜：05041_hama⟧: beach
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧: coast, seashore
